# <span id="aanchor468"></span> Define Custom Field Labels

The Custom Fields screen allows an administrator to designate labels for custom fields available in screens throughout the FLOWCAL application, such as the Meter Editor, Source Analysis Editor, and Location Editor. Custom fields are also available for history records, such as flow data (periodic) and source analysis.

Custom fields accommodate data that is specific to a user’s company and that may not be standard in FLOWCAL.

<div class="example">

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerBRDToggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_BRDToggler MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Example">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Example</a>

In the Meter Editor, many fields on the Custom Fields tab can be edited, as well as other fields available on the General tab.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 669;height: 227;" />

</div>

<div class="procedure">

To access the Custom Fields screen:

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Settings Manager**.
2.  Select **Custom Fields** within the **Application** group.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 529;height: 384;" />

</div>

Administrators must have Application Process – FLOWCAL Options privileges, granted from the User or Group Access screen.

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Details">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Button and Tab Details</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Details">

The following options are available on the Custom Fields screen:

- **Edit** - Enable edit mode and specify field names.
- **Save** - Save changes to field names.
- **Table** - Create drop-down values for custom field tabs where drop-downs are supported.
- **Cancel** - Cancel edits and do not save changes.
- **Exit** - Exit the Custom Fields screen.

Each tab in the Custom Fields screen corresponds to a screen in the FLOWCAL application:

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Create Label">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Create Custom Field Labels</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Create Label">

<div class="procedure">

To create a custom field label:

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Settings Manager**, and select **Custom Fields** within the **Application** group.
2.  Select a tab and click **Edit**.
3.  Click in the **Field Name** field and enter the label.
4.  Click **Save**.

</div>

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Create Drop-Down">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Create Custom Drop-Down Fields</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Create Drop-Down">

<div class="procedure">

To create a custom drop-down field:

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Settings Manager**, and select **Custom Fields** within the **Application** group.

2.  Select a tab and click **Edit**.

3.  Click the **Use Drop-Down?** field to enable the option.

4.  While the field name is selected, click **Table**.

    The associated database table and field name will display in the title bar.

5.  Click **New**.

6.  Enter the drop-down value in the **User Choice** field.

7.  Click **Save**.

8.  Repeat steps 5 through 7 for each drop-down value.

9.  To edit or delete a drop-down value, select the item from the grid and click **Edit** or **Delete**.

10. Click **Exit** to return to the Custom Fields screen.

</div>

</div>
